title: Carrier
description: An energy carrier, such as hydrogen, heat, or natural gas. Every flow of a carrier is recorded as energy flow; fuel carriers use the lower heating value. Carrier buses reference a carrier, and conversion links may reference one to label their technology.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type must have unique names, but components of different types can share a name.

co2_emissions.description: CO2 emitted per unit of carrier energy consumed, on the lower heating value. Zero for carriers with no direct emissions. Units: t/MWh.
